title: Construct tight-binding Hamiltonian
action: Implement the tight-binding model for (DMe-DCNQI)2Cu using the LUMO of DCNQI and the Cu dxy orbital. Use lattice parameters and atomic coordinates from Sizger et al. (1993) and hopping integrals from Kato et al. (1989). Build the Bloch Hamiltonian H(k) over the Brillouin zone.
description: Intermediate stage to construct the tight-binding model; not directly scored.

title: Compute Fermi surface
action: Diagonalize H(k) on a sufficiently fine 3D k-point mesh. Determine the Fermi energy from charge neutrality and extract the Fermi surface sheets (FS1, FS2, FS3). Verify that FS2 and FS3 touch at point P.
description: Intermediate stage to obtain the electronic band structure and Fermi surfaces required for orbit analysis.

title: Compute dHvA frequencies and cyclotron masses
action: For the cyclotron orbits α (H∥c, θ=0°), β (θ=60°, ω=0°), γ (ω=0°), δ₂ (ω=25°), ε₅ (ω=25°), ε₈ (ω=33°), calculate extremal cross-sectional areas and convert to dHvA frequencies. Compute band cyclotron masses. Write the results to the output CSV.
description: CSV file containing the computed dHvA frequencies and band cyclotron masses for six specified orbits. Used to compare against reference calculations.
